detail.longDescription: The first time I saw the term "content engineering" mentioned on LinkedIn, I rolled my eyes and assumed it was another AI trend designed to end the careers of content writers like me. As I dug into it, though, I realized content engineering isn't just another AI-slop trend claiming to replace writers, editors, strategists, or subject matter experts.
